stations.title: Bridie
stations.say: The till is out by pennies again.
stations.note: New fares in pounds and pence.

stations.title: Borrowed till
stations.text: Adds the morning up, nearly right

stations.title: Day's takings
stations.text: Every fare counted to the penny
stations.note: And printed the same on any ticket.

captions: The hut at Lanternquay. Bridie wants the council's new fares added up right.
The borrowed till adds the morning up, and the total comes out a few pennies wrong.
You write the till's sums, its rounding and its printed amounts, exact to the penny.
Now the morning adds up to the penny, and every ticket shows its fare the same way.
Next comes the timetable board. For now, the till and the tickets agree to the penny.
